senses.en_definition: A bow used to play a string instrument, or a curved line forming part of a circle.
senses.zh_definition: 用于演奏弦乐器的弓；也指构成圆周一部分的弧线。
senses.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jindaqq strument tal-kordi, jew linja mgħawġa li tifforma parti minn ċirku.

senses.zh_definition: 弓，例如演奏弦乐器时使用的琴弓。
弧；弧线。

formal.zh: 学生在圆上标出两个点，并在两点之间画了一段弧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-ark tal-vjolin? David: Fil-kaxxa, ħdejn il-vjolin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the violin bow? David: In the case, beside the violin.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：小提琴弓在哪里？戴维：在琴盒里，小提琴旁边。

messages.en: Where is the violin bow?

messages.zh: 在琴盒里，小提琴旁边。
messages.en: In the case, beside the violin.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张 ark 图卡：一张画小提琴弓，一张画圆弧；分别配上 tal-vjolin 和 ta' ċirku，靠搭配区分词义。

senses.en_definition: A brake used to slow or stop a vehicle; also a break or short pause from an activity.
senses.zh_definition: 使车辆减速或停止的刹车装置；也指工作或其他活动中的短暂休息。
senses.mt_definition: Apparat biex vettura tnaqqas il-veloċità jew tieqaf; ukoll waqfa qasira mix-xogħol jew minn attività.

senses.zh_definition: 刹车；制动器。

senses.en_definition: brake (device used to slow or stop a vehicle)
senses.zh_definition: 刹车装置，用于使车辆减速或停止。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tas-sewqan, l-għalliem spjega meta s-sewwieq għandu jagħfas il-brejk.
formal.en: During the driving lesson, the instructor explained when the driver should press the brake.
formal.zh: 在驾驶课上，教练讲解了驾驶员应该在什么时候踩刹车。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieħdu brejk? Ilna naħdmu sagħtejn. Mark: Iva, ejja nieħdu kafè u mbagħad inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we take a break? We've been working for two hours. Mark: Yes, let's have a coffee and then carry on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们休息一下好吗？已经工作两个小时了。马克：好，喝杯咖啡再继续吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们休息一下好吗？已经工作两个小时了。
messages.en: Shall we take a break? We've been working for two hours.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieħdu kafè u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieħdu kafè u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.zh: 好，喝杯咖啡再继续吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's have a coffee and then carry on.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让动作停一停”串联两义：车上踩 brejk 是刹车，工作时 tieħu brejk 是休息；靠情境区分。

senses.en_definition: A two-wheeled vehicle that a rider usually moves by pushing pedals.
senses.zh_definition: 通常由骑车人踩动踏板来驱动的两轮交通工具。
senses.mt_definition: Vettura b'żewġ roti li normalment titmexxa minn persuna billi tagħfas il-pedali.

senses.zh_definition: 自行车；脚踏车。
自行车；脚踏车。

formal.en: The student uses his bicycle to go to school every day.
formal.zh: 这名学生每天骑自行车上学。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif se tmur il-ħanut? Ġużeppi: Bil-bajsikil. Nasal malajr.
colloquial.en: Marta: How are you going to the shop? Ġużeppi: By bicycle. I'll get there quickly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你怎么去商店？朱塞佩：骑自行车，很快就到。

senses.en_definition: Velvet, a fabric with a soft surface; also something soft and pleasant to touch.
senses.zh_definition: 天鹅绒，一种表面柔软的织物；也指摸起来柔软舒适的东西。
senses.mt_definition: Drapp b'wiċċ artab; ukoll xi ħaġa ratba li tagħti sensazzjoni pjaċevoli meta tmissha.

senses.zh_definition: 天鹅绒。

senses.en_definition: sth. soft and pleasant to the touch
senses.zh_definition: 触感柔软舒适的东西。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Għall-purtieri tas-sala ntgħażel bellus aħmar minħabba d-dehra eleganti tiegħu.
formal.en: Red velvet was chosen for the hall's curtains because of its elegant appearance.
formal.zh: 大厅的窗帘选用了红色天鹅绒，因为它看起来很典雅。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-kuxxin artab ħafna. Marija: Veru, qisu bellus meta tmissu.
colloquial.en: Anna: This cushion is very soft. Marija: It really is; it feels like velvet.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个靠垫真软。玛丽亚：确实，摸起来像天鹅绒。

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指轻轻划过天鹅绒表面，把 bellus 和柔软舒服的触感一起记住。

senses.en_definition: A gull or seagull; also gulls or seagulls referred to collectively.
senses.zh_definition: 指鸥或海鸥，也可统称多只鸥或海鸥；具体数量须结合语境理解。
senses.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal dawn l-għasafar flimkien.

senses.zh_definition: 鸥，一类鸟。
海鸥。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-port, l-istudenti raw gawwi jtir fuq il-baħar.
formal.en: During the visit to the harbour, the students saw a gull flying over the sea.
formal.zh: 参观港口时，学生们看见一只海鸥在海面上方飞翔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-gawwi ħdejn id-dgħajsa! Mark: Qed narah. Issa qed itir lejn il-port.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that gull beside the boat! Mark: I can see it. Now it's flying towards the harbour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看船旁边那只海鸥！马克：我看见了。它现在正朝港口飞去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看船旁边那只海鸥！
messages.en: Look at that gull beside the boat!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed narah. Issa qed itir lejn il-port.

senses.en_definition: A rough or poor shelter or dwelling; also an enclosure used to keep pigs or rabbits.
senses.zh_definition: 粗陋的棚屋或贫旧住宅；也可指饲养猪或兔子的圈舍。
senses.mt_definition: Kenn jew dar fqira u sempliċi; ukoll post magħluq fejn jinżammu l-ħnieżer jew il-fniek.

senses.zh_definition: 简陋棚屋；用简单材料搭成的小屋。

senses.en_definition: sty, pigsty (an enclosure where pigs are kept)
senses.zh_definition: 猪圈；饲养猪的圈舍。

formal.zh: 文件描述了一间旧棚屋，人们曾用它躲避恶劣天气。

colloquial.en: Maja: Is the rabbit still in the hutch? Pawlu: Yes, and it has fresh water and food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：兔子还在兔舍里吗？保罗：是的，里面有干净的饮水和食物。

senses.en_definition: Jellyfish: soft-bodied sea animals that may sting.
senses.zh_definition: 水母：身体柔软、部分种类会蜇人的海洋动物。
senses.mt_definition: Annimali tal-baħar b'ġisem artab li jistgħu jniggżu.

senses.zh_definition: 水母。
水母。

formal.en: Because of the presence of jellyfish in the bay, swimmers were advised to be careful.
formal.zh: 由于海湾里有水母，游泳者被提醒要小心。

colloquial.en: Maja: Are there jellyfish in the water? Mark: Yes, I saw a few near the shore. Let's stay here.

senses.en_definition: A built-up area where people live.
senses.zh_definition: 有人居住、房屋等建筑较为集中的区域。

formal.zh: 该项目规划在建成区边缘修建一条新路。

senses.en_definition: Relating to the apostles or to their teaching and mission.
senses.zh_definition: 与使徒，或与使徒的教导和使命有关的。
senses.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-appostli, mat-tagħlim tagħhom jew mal-missjoni tagħhom.

senses.zh_definition: 因某种行为损害个人或群体的荣誉、名声而产生的耻辱或羞辱。
senses.mt_definition: Telf ta' ġieħ jew ta' reputazzjoni minħabba mġiba ħażina jew mhux xierqa.

senses.en_definition: To come into view or become visible suddenly.
senses.zh_definition: 突然进入视野，或原本看不见的事物一下子显现出来。
senses.mt_definition: Jidher f'daqqa jew isir viżibbli wara li ma kienx jidher.

formal.zh: 观测期间，地平线上突然出现了一道强光。

colloquial.en: Sara: What is an atomist? Pawlu: Someone who believes that matter is made of atoms. Sara: So the word refers to a person? Pawlu: Yes, a person who holds that view.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是原子论者？
messages.en: What is an atomist?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jemmen li l-materja hija magħmula minn atomi.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jemmen li l-materja hija magħmula minn atomi.
messages.zh: 就是认为物质由原子构成的人。
messages.en: Someone who believes that matter is made of atoms.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 所以这个词指的是人？
messages.en: So the word refers to a person?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal persuna li tħaddan dik il-fehma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal persuna li tħaddan dik il-fehma.
messages.zh: 对，指持这种观点的人。
messages.en: Yes, a person who holds that view.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位指着原子示意图讲解观点的人，把 atomista 与“原子论者”整词配对，记住它指持某种观点的人。

senses.en_definition: To kick with the legs, or to react with excitement.
senses.zh_definition: 用腿踢蹬，也可指因兴奋而作出明显反应。
senses.mt_definition: Jagħti daqqa b'siequ jew jirreaġixxi b'eċċitament.

senses.zh_definition: 踢；用脚或腿踢蹬。
兴奋地作出反应；因激动而明显地动起来。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel qamas meta sema' ħoss qawwi, u l-ħaddiem resaq lura.
formal.en: The horse kicked when it heard a loud noise, and the worker stepped back.
formal.zh: 马听到一声巨响后踢蹬起来，工作人员向后退了一步。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irreaġixxa Ben meta għedtlu li sejrin il-baħar? Sara: Qamas bil-ferħ u mar jiġri jġib ix-xugaman.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Ben react when you told him we were going to the beach? Sara: He reacted with excitement and ran to get his towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你告诉本我们要去海边时，他有什么反应？萨拉：他高兴得激动起来，跑去拿毛巾了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Ben meta għedtlu li sejrin il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Ben meta għedtlu li sejrin il-baħar?
messages.zh: 你告诉本我们要去海边时，他有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Ben react when you told him we were going to the beach?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qamas bil-ferħ u mar jiġri jġib ix-xugaman.
messages.mt_standard: Qamas bil-ferħ u mar jiġri jġib ix-xugaman.
messages.zh: 他高兴得激动起来，跑去拿毛巾了。
messages.en: He reacted with excitement and ran to get his towel.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作画面记忆：马用腿踢蹬，孩子听到好消息兴奋起来；再按语境区分两个义项。

senses.en_definition: To feed a baby or young animal with milk from the breast.
senses.zh_definition: 用乳汁喂养婴儿或幼小动物，通常指直接哺乳。
senses.mt_definition: Titma' tarbija jew ferħ ta' annimal bil-ħalib mis-sider.

senses.zh_definition: 哺乳；用乳汁喂养婴儿或幼小动物。

formal.mt: Il-kamra privata tipprovdi post kwiet fejn omm tista' tredda' lit-tarbija tagħha.
formal.en: The private room provides a quiet place where a mother can breastfeed her baby.
formal.zh: 这间独立房间为母亲提供一个可以给婴儿哺乳的安静场所。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn nista' noqgħod biex tredda' lit-tarbija? Anna: Ejja, tista' toqgħod hawn ħdejja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I sit so that you can breastfeed the baby? Anna: Come, you can sit here beside me.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我可以坐在哪里，方便你给宝宝喂奶？Anna：来，你可以坐在我旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' noqgħod biex tredda' lit-tarbija?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' noqgħod biex tredda' lit-tarbija?
messages.zh: 我可以坐在哪里，方便你给宝宝喂奶？
messages.en: Where can I sit so that you can breastfeed the baby?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 来，你可以坐在我旁边。
messages.en: Come, you can sit here beside me.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“母亲抱着宝宝喂奶”的画面中记忆；搭配 lit-tarbija，整组联想为“给宝宝哺乳”。

senses.en_definition: A surname with an occupational origin, used as a person's family name.
senses.zh_definition: 一个源自职业称谓的姓氏，用作个人的家族姓；中文可音译为“布蒂吉耶奇”。
senses.mt_definition: Kunjom li oriġina minn isem ta' xogħol u li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

senses.en_definition: a surname originating as an occupation
senses.zh_definition: 一个源自职业称谓的姓氏，中文可音译为“布蒂吉耶奇”。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Buttiġieġ għandu jiffirma l-formola u jikteb id-data.
formal.en: Mr Buttiġieġ must sign the form and write the date.
formal.zh: 布蒂吉耶奇先生须在表格上签名并填写日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jinkiteb il-kunjom tiegħek? Pawlu: Buttiġieġ, b'żewġ t.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do you spell your surname? Pawlu: Buttiġieġ, with two t's.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的姓怎么拼？保罗：Buttiġieġ，有两个 t。

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.zh: 你的姓怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (访客)
messages.zh: Buttiġieġ，有两个 t。
messages.en: Buttiġieġ, with two t's.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Buttiġieġ 放进签到表的姓氏栏来记；书写时留意大写 B、双写 tt 和两个带点的 ġ。

senses.en_definition: The third-person masculine singular form of għand, meaning at or to him or it, and commonly expressing that he or it has something.
senses.zh_definition: għand的第三人称阳性单数代词形式，表示在他或它那里、到他或它那里，也常用来表达他或它拥有某物。
senses.mt_definition: Forma ta' għand għat-tielet persuna maskili singular, li tindika post għand persuna jew pussess minnha.

senses.en_definition: third-person masculine singular pronominal form of għand:
senses.zh_definition: għand的第三人称阳性单数代词形式，所指对象为“他”或阳性单数的“它”。
在他或它那里；到他或它那里，具体含义由语境决定。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu kopja tat-test biex ikun jista' jsegwi l-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Each student has a copy of the text so that they can follow the lesson.
formal.zh: 每名学生都有一份课文，以便跟上课堂内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għandu l-ktieb tiegħi? Anna: Iva, mur għandu wara l-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark have my book? Anna: Yes, go to him after the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的书在Mark那里吗？Anna：对，下课后去他那里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我的书在Mark那里吗？
messages.en: Does Mark have my book?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 对，下课后去他那里吧。
messages.en: Yes, go to him after the lesson.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“书在他那里，所以他有书”串起处所和拥有两种用法，再加一句mur għandu记“到他那里去”；这是学习联想。

senses.en_definition: Situated in the middle or toward the central line of something.
senses.zh_definition: 位于某物中间，或靠近其中央线的。
senses.mt_definition: Li jinsab fin-nofs jew lejn il-linja ċentrali ta' xi ħaġa.

senses.zh_definition: 中间的，居中的；在解剖等位置描述中指靠近中线的、内侧的。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, il-pjan nofsi jaqsam il-ġisem f'nofs tal-lemin u nofs tax-xellug.
formal.en: In the diagram, the median plane divides the body into a right half and a left half.
formal.zh: 图中，正中面将身体分成右半部和左半部。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser nofsi hawn? Luka: Ifisser li jinsab fin-nofs. Ħares lejn il-punt nofsi ta' din il-linja. Sara: Issa fhimt fejn hu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does nofsi mean here? Luka: It means that it is in the middle. Look at the middle point of this line. Sara: Now I understand where it is.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 nofsi 是什么意思？卢卡：意思是位于中间。看这条线的中间点。萨拉：现在我明白它在哪里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 nofsi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does nofsi mean here?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jinsab fin-nofs. Ħares lejn il-punt nofsi ta' din il-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jinsab fin-nofs. Ħares lejn il-punt nofsi ta' din il-linja.
messages.zh: 意思是位于中间。看这条线的中间点。
messages.en: It means that it is in the middle. Look at the middle point of this line.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白它在哪里了。
messages.en: Now I understand where it is.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一条线并标出正中央，把 nofsi 写在中央标记旁，记住它描述中间或靠近中线的位置。

senses.en_definition: A prayer for a deceased man, asking God to grant him heaven or rest his soul.
senses.zh_definition: 悼念已故男性时使用的祈愿语，意为“愿主赐他天堂”或“愿他安息”。
senses.mt_definition: Talba għal raġel li miet, biex Alla jagħtih il-ġenna u r-ruħ tiegħu tistrieħ fis-sliem.

senses.en_definition: God rest his soul; God grant him heaven
senses.zh_definition: 愿他的灵魂安息；愿上帝赐他天堂，用于悼念已故男性。

formal.mt: Niftakru b'rispett f'Pawlu, Alla jagħtih il-ġenna, u fil-ħidma tiegħu għall-komunità.
formal.en: We respectfully remember Pawlu, may God rest his soul, and his work for the community.
formal.zh: 我们怀着敬意缅怀保罗，愿他安息，也铭记他为社区所做的工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għallmek tagħmel il-ħobż? Mark: In-nannu, Alla jagħtih il-ġenna. Kien jagħmlu kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who taught you to make bread? Mark: My grandfather, may God rest his soul. He used to make it every Sunday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁教你做面包的？马克：我祖父，愿他安息。他以前每个星期日都会做。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁教你做面包的？
messages.en: Who taught you to make bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu, Alla jagħtih il-ġenna. Kien jagħmlu kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu, Alla jagħtih il-ġenna. Kien jagħmlu kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
messages.zh: 我祖父，愿他安息。他以前每个星期日都会做。
messages.en: My grandfather, may God rest his soul. He used to make it every Sunday.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“提到已故祖父，轻声补一句愿他安息”的场景记整句；这里祈愿的对象是男性。
